messages.subject: problem with installation
parts:
Hi, I've been trying to install mxmaps, but R send me this message 
no fue posible abrir la URL (wasn't possible to open the URL) 'https://famuvie.github.io/breedR/bin/macosx/el-capitan/contrib/3.5/PACKAGES'

May you please help me with that?

messages.author: b5d6b2ba02a324a6
messages.subject: Re: problem with installation
parts: The solution was to run defaults write org.R-project.R force.LANG en_US.UTF-8 and then install mxmaps
